asr.full_text: Investing bitcoin is pretty simple. Let's begin! From your user homepage, press the Lend Bitcoin button. The Invest Bitcoin box will appear. The exchange rate is displayed. Enter the amount you wish to lend. Your interest expectancy is also shown for your convenience. After you have read the terms of service, rules and regulations and agree to the terms, check the small box. You may now choose to pay from a third-party wallet or from your BitConnect wallet using the buttons on the bottom of your screen. It's that simple. Once you have made a selection of which wallet to use, a confirmation box will appear. Let's go over the information on your confirmation form. It displays where your funds are coming from your transaction type where you are sending funds to the amount being taken out of your wallet your exchange rate capital release and your transaction fee remember the lend request will expire in 12 hours if no payment is received hit the confirmation button okay now you're all set. The Lend request you have made is complete. But there are still more steps you must complete. Now your system pool request form will display your Lend Bitcoin ID. You can double check all your transaction concerns here. Make sure you send the exact BTC amount to the Bitcoin address displayed and your Lend Bitcoin request processes as soon as the payment is confirmed your 12-hour countdown has just started you can keep track of exactly how much time you have to fulfill your transaction try to remember completion of the transaction will take time keep in mind bitconnect has a three confirmation minimum to complete the transaction now copy your bitcoin address located in the box and go to your blockchain wallet. Now select send from your blockchain wallet. Paste a copied Bitcoin address into the to space. Go to your BitConnect member dashboard. From your system pool request form, copy the exact amount displayed above the code. Paste the copied amount into the BTC space look over your information and select next step press send your wallet tab will display a confirmation message stating you have successfully sent Bitcoin go to your bit connect user dashboard and on your system pull request form a payment completion message will be displayed waiting for confirmation will also be displayed. Your payment received and will get fully completed with three Bitcoin network confirmations. On your user homepage, you will see an awaiting confirmation message toward the bottom of the screen. Check over your transaction details. Go to your transaction tab under your dashboard menu. You will see a record of your transaction there ,evading three, network confirmation

visual.limitations: These frames do not establish the legitimacy of the offer, whether funds were sent, or whether any return was delivered.

visual.observation: A “System pool request” asks the user to send an exact Bitcoin amount to a displayed Bitcoin address or scan a visible QR code. The dialog shows “Waiting for payment” and states that the lending request will expire automatically if payment is not received within 12 hours.

visual.potential_relevance: This connects a time-limited Bitcoin transfer request and a displayed payment destination to the lending request, which is a concrete action-and-condition relationship for review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish who controls the address, whether the QR code was used, whether payment occurred, or whether the requested lending outcome followed.
